The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui's]] '''South Pole''' was a large polar [[Water/Legends|ice]] cap. Due to a slight wobble in Bothawui's axial plain, the result of the catastrophic destruction of the [[Both system|system's]] [[Fervse'dra|third planet]], the South Pole's ice cap expanded and receded in seventy-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] cycles.
